description: Unit test suite for the AmqpClientActor class, focusing on connection handling, message consumption, session recovery, and command forwarding in an AMQP messaging setup using Mockito and Akka TestKit.

classes.name: AmqpClientActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for verifying the behavior of AmqpClientActor, including connection management, message handling, and recovery in AMQP environments.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the actor system and mock connection before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after all tests.

methods.name: stopMockServers
methods.description: Stops any running mock servers used during tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Resets mocks and prepares the test probe and actor references before each test.

methods.name: prepareSession
methods.description: Configures mock session and message consumer behavior.

methods.name: invalidSpecificOptionsThrowConnectionConfigurationInvalidException
methods.description: Tests that invalid specific options in connection configuration throw the correct exception.

methods.name: testExceptionDuringJMSConnectionCreation
methods.description: Verifies behavior when creating the JMS connection fails.

methods.name: testConnectionHandling
methods.description: Verifies connection and disconnection requests and status updates.

methods.name: testReconnect
methods.description: Tests repeated connect/disconnect cycles for stability.

methods.name: testReconnectAndVerifyConnectionStatus
methods.description: Verifies connection status transitions during reconnect scenarios.

methods.name: verifyConnectionStatus
methods.description: Helper to verify connection status via actor messages.

methods.name: awaitStatusInStatusResponse
methods.description: Helper that blocks until expected status appears in resource status response.

methods.name: sendCommandDuringInit
methods.description: Tests sending commands during initial connection phase.

methods.name: sendConnectCommandWhenAlreadyConnected
methods.description: Asserts that multiple connection commands don't cause redundant reconnects.

methods.name: sendDisconnectWhenAlreadyDisconnected
methods.description: Ensures that disconnect requests on already disconnected state are ignored.

methods.name: testStartConnectionFails
methods.description: Verifies failure handling when starting the JMS connection fails.

methods.name: testCreateSessionFails
methods.description: Verifies failure handling when creating a JMS session fails.

methods.name: testCreateConsumerFails
methods.description: Verifies failure when creating a message consumer fails.

methods.name: testCloseConnectionFails
methods.description: Ensures proper handling if closing the connection throws an exception.

methods.name: testConnectionRestoredExpectRecreateSession
methods.description: Validates session recreation and message handling after connection restoration.

methods.name: testConsumeMessageAndExpectForwardToProxyActor
methods.description: Checks that received messages are correctly forwarded as commands.

methods.name: testConsumeMessageAndExpectForwardToProxyActorAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Validates message processing and response handling via command reply.

methods.name: testTargetAddressPlaceholderReplacement
methods.description: Tests address placeholder replacement logic in targets.

methods.name: testReceiveThingEventAndExpectForwardToJMSProducer
methods.description: Tests forwarding of outgoing Thing events to the JMS producer.

methods.name: testConsumerRecreationFailureWhenConnected
methods.description: Verifies recovery when consumer creation fails during active connection.

methods.name: testSpecialCharactersInSourceAndRequestMetrics
methods.description: Checks handling of special and Unicode characters in source addresses and metrics.

methods.name: testRetrieveConnectionStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieving connection status information.

calls: Expectations when calling onMessage, verify, or interacting with mocks
